name: neurarch-mcp
description: Before a training job takes a GPU: peak memory at its batch, the smallest card, max batch per card, the cost, and whether it forward-passes.
long_description: Call size_training_job before a training job launches and the agent learns what it actually needs: the training peak at its batch (weights and optimizer state, activations, stored attention scores), the smallest card that holds it, the largest batch each card holds, a two-card split when one card does not, and what one run costs. The number is a calibrated estimate under AdamW with bf16 autocast, fitted on 178 measured runs across 41 architectures; held out, the median error is 7% and it flagged 113 of the 131 times a run did not fit a card where accelerate estimate-memory flagged at most 8; on 25 runs measured after the fit the median miss is 14%. Then whether it forward-passes: the design linter (lint_model) and the full readiness verdict (check_design), plus layers, parameters, FLOPs, 81 bundled reference architectures and runnable PyTorch export. All of that runs on your machine. check_pins finds Hugging Face downloads not pinned to a commit, offline. Three tools reach the network when called: plan renders the same card the Neurarch CI bot posts, history says what this exact structure measured the last time it trained inside your organisation, and model_changes reads the public change record for a Hugging Face model (what changed between revisions, and whether it is breaking).

model_path.title: Model file
model_path.description: A PyTorch .py file or a .neurarch.json graph. Try zoo:qwen2.5-7b for a bundled reference architecture.

tools.name: size_training_job
tools.description: Call before launching a training job: peak memory at your batch, fits / borderline / does not fit per card against an upper bound, the smallest card that holds it, max batch, two-card split, one run's cost, and whether the data fits the model.

tools.name: diagnose_oom
tools.description: Call after a CUDA out-of-memory error, before changing batch size: the one cause (too big, fragmented, another process, undeclared memory) and fixes, least invasive first.

tools.name: check_edit
tools.description: Call after editing a model's config or architecture, before training: silent edit bugs (vocab resize, tying, heads, RoPE, LoRA targets) and the memory delta.

tools.name: check_parallel_layout
tools.description: Call before a multi-GPU (TP / PP / DP / CP / EP) training launch: whether the split is legal, a per-stage table, the predicted step slowdown against a balanced split and the split that fixes it. Predicted from the graph, not measured.

tools.name: check_serving_config
tools.description: Call before a vLLM, SGLang or llama.cpp launch: TP against the heads, served length against the context, KV memory and concurrency, quantization against the card, chat template and sampler defaults.

tools.name: check_pins
tools.description: Hugging Face downloads not pinned to a commit (from_pretrained, vllm serve, hf download, YAML model keys), with the fix spelled for each file. Bandit B615 rules, offline.

tools.name: model_changes
tools.description: What changed upstream in a tracked Hugging Face model, revision by revision (config, tokenizer, chat template, weights), breaking or not, optionally since your pinned commit. Reads public files from neurarch.com.

tools.name: plan
tools.description: Will it run, what it costs, GPU fit, your .neurarch.yml rules, and what this structure scored last time it trained here.

tools.name: history
tools.description: What this exact structure scored the last time it trained in your organisation. Needs an API key.

tools.name: trace_model
tools.description: Run the model once in Python with hooks for a graph with real shapes.

tools.name: describe_architecture
tools.description: One-call orientation: pipeline, depth, params, MACs, hotspots, validation.

tools.name: lint_model
tools.description: The structural design rules, with provenance.

tools.name: check_design
tools.description: Readiness, cost, deployment fit and the decisions left to the human.

tools.name: rank_designs
tools.description: Order candidate designs; blocked last, ties stay ties, calibration included.

tools.name: layer_impact
tools.description: Blast radius of changing a layer.

tools.name: find_models
tools.description: Find model definitions in a repository.

prompts.name: review_design
prompts.description: A structured design review, every number from the tools.
prompts.text: Review the design of the current model: run describe_architecture, validate_model, lint_model and check_design, and report a verdict, the risks, and the edits worth making, every number from the tools.

prompts.name: pre_train_checklist
prompts.description: What to check before spending GPU time.
prompts.text: Run the pre-training checklist on the current model: graph well-formed, no blocking rule, warnings listed, forward pass runs, cost and GPU fit, shapes known, decisions still owed.

prompts.name: shrink_for_target
prompts.description: Fit a parameter, memory or latency budget with the least damage.
prompts.text: Bring the current model within this budget: {target}. Find where the budget lives, propose at most three variants, check each with layer_impact and rank them with rank_designs.

prompts.name: compare_with_reference
prompts.description: Put the model next to a published architecture.
prompts.text: Compare the current model with the reference architecture {architecture} from the bundled library: depth, width, attention configuration, normalisation, parameter distribution, and the rules that fire on one but not the other.

prompts.name: explain_finding
prompts.description: What a finding means and the smallest edit that clears it.
prompts.text: Explain the finding {rule} on the current model: what the rule checks, the evidence behind it, and the smallest edit that clears it with its blast radius.

prompts.name: precheck_change
prompts.description: Before a changed model takes a GPU or traffic: what changed, what the job needs, whether the launch is legal.
prompts.text: Pre-check the change from {base} to the current model, headed for {launch}: check_edit against the base, size_training_job, then check_parallel_layout or check_serving_config for the launch, and model_changes if the base is a Hugging Face id. End with a go / no-go table.

prompts.name: precheck_serving
prompts.description: Before a vLLM, SGLang or llama.cpp launch: will it start, what fits, has the model moved upstream.
prompts.text: Pre-check this serving launch: {command} on {gpu}. Run check_serving_config, read what it skipped, then model_changes on the served model, and say whether it will start and the one flag to change first.

prompts.name: pin_downloads
prompts.description: Find Hugging Face downloads not pinned to a commit, and what each model changed upstream.
prompts.text: Run check_pins over {paths}, then model_changes for each model it names, and propose the pin each finding's fix spells for its file.
